steps.note: Open the single-stage creation flow required for configuring a traffic-light auction.
Configure the event as a traffic-light auction; the case does not provide numeric green and yellow bounds.
Provide the mandatory event title so the auction can be published.
Apply the auction pricing template before adding line items.
Add the auction line item needed for vendor bidding.
Complete the pricing sheet for the line item.
Commit a bidding schedule before publishing.
Invite two vendors so one can bid at the boundary and the other just above it.
Confirm the auction reached a published project page before bidding.

Confirm the first vendor's bid was accepted.
Have the second vendor submit a bid just above the intended boundary.
